question:
Read the given sentence carefully. Change the meaning of the sentence by replacing the underlined word with its ANTONYM from the following options.

His father warned him not to use __vulgar__ language at home.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vulgar"** means something that is lacking sophistication or good taste; unrefined or crude. (अशिष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **He was reprimanded for using **vulgar** language during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Decorous"** refers to something that is in keeping with good taste and propriety; polite and restrained. (सभ्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The students were asked to maintain a **decorous** demeanor during the ceremony.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'vulgar'** is **'decorous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Impervious** (अभेद्य): Not allowing fluid to pass through; unable to be affected by.

 
 
• **Example:** The coat is **impervious** to rain.
 
 
 
• **Licentious** (उच्छृंखल): Promiscuous and unprincipled in sexual matters.
 
 
• **Example: **The **licentious** behavior of some celebrities often makes headlines.
 
 
 
• **Ribald** (फूहड़): Referring to sexual matters in an amusingly rude or irreverent way.
 
 
• **Example:** The comedian's **ribald** jokes were not suitable for the family audience.
